subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased and consolidated into existing availability/depth-aware sub-agent guidance, changed into a coordinated no-nested-spawn policy, or closed as already covered by current guidance?
rationale: The branch is small but changes maintainer-owned prompt policy where current main and the latest release already have overlapping guidance and support configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into existing Tooling, Messaging, Sub-Agent Delegation, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config behavior, docs, tests, and every prompt surface together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat current shipped guidance as sufficient and close this stale prompt-policy branch manually.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into existing Tooling, Messaging, Sub-Agent Delegation, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this maintainer-labeled prompt-policy proposal and already made the product-direction call against the related tool-policy approach.
